cards.name: Five Hit Barrage (Yamazaki)
cards.desc:
Taught by [[syEIVzBQ]] for Yamazaki clan members.

Grab your target and uppercut their stomach, launching them in the air. Follow up with rapid punches, sending them flying. 2.2 base damage on first punch, 2x3 (6) base damage on barrage, 5.8 base damage on final hit (14 total), .9s stun, 31s cooldown on miss, 36s cooldown on hit.

![giphy.gif](https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExM2k2cHVraXUwODI5aWdoamFzaWxlcDBqdTEyeGEwdXYxenNyazYyYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/QMff1QJJSh8az2zKTO/giphy.gif)

cards.name: Wu Ultimate Skills (Wu)
cards.desc:
Taught by Wu Xing for Wu clan members.

Thirteen-Fold Kill: Put one hand up to block vision, then hit them from the side with the other arm. 11 base damage, .8 second stun, 28 second cooldown, guardbreaks. Increases Jaw breaking count by 1. _This skill counts as a Clan Skill and does not take a Skill Slot._

![giphy.gif](https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExazZqaWhmOXYxNHlpMjFwNzU3MDhvdW5pMjluaTV0enN0aWxoOWRndyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Uf0mFuxwbCUqg9umdx/giphy.gif)

Demolition Fist: A barrage of multiple punches in a row. 1.5x8 base damage, .8 second stun, 37 second cooldown. _This skill does not count as a Clan Skill, and will still take a Skill Slot._

![giphy.gif](https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdnI5bzJsYmQ2OWZvNWFjOXJoOXBncnE4ajJ5YjczNmI3MGNrcHRlMiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/hfT6DKRBdAIWAnJ85L/giphy.gif)

cards.name: Dress/Three-Level Attack (Hanma)
cards.desc:
Taught by [[BxoZG3EF]] for Hanma clan members if you meet the requirements.

If you are lean then you will get Three-Level Attack, otherwise you will receive Dress.

---

Dress:  Grab the enemy and spin them around you like nunchucks before throwing them away. .6x12 (7.2) base damage on spinning, 3.2 base damage on throw, .8 second ragdoll, 26 second cooldown on miss, 30 second cooldown on hit.

![giphy.gif](https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYXhhMG84NnFsbWNhbW14czM2Mm9ld2xwdjhmeWJvZmtweXYzYWp3diZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/poyA9S3KMuzX5vuRNR/giphy.gif)

Three-Level Attack: Do a short dash forward, then send out three rapid punches. 3.1x3 (9.3) base damage, .85 second stun, 37 second cooldown.

![giphy.gif](https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbjNxMzZvNnBsYjM5OWtpM3Y1dW81YzN2ejc3amthMzd4NzAzMWM2NCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/zkXpxamehv9DCZDXAy/giphy.gif)

cards.desc:

Increases damage by 15% and reduces cooldowns by 33%, Fighting Reflex charges 15% faster, heals 17.5% of health on activation. Stamina consumption is increased by 10%. Lasts 45 seconds.

![giphy.gif](https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOHV2YXdyenI3dTJkdWlqZW10dXIzaGlicGFvbDkxMmgwZG5wYXN5dCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/L95kmLYH5xXSVnfczU/giphy.gif)

cards.desc:
Taught by [[VRkKjuGk]] for Tokita clan members.

Change of Scenery: Grab the opponent and throw them upside down behind you. 12 base damage, 1.2 second ragdoll, 23 second cooldown on miss, 29 second cooldown on hit. Can be used on ragdolled players.

![giphy.gif](https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbjNvaWZjMGlqYm05Z2lmM3gycnJuZnZjczNkdDFpNHpnMjZsdzMzaiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/o1DyF7AOe1iM2SHXBI/giphy.gif)

cards.desc:
Taught by [[FDYE9yBP]] if you meet the requirements

Amateur Armbar: When used on a standing target, attempt a flying armbar, and throw an elbow at the target’s head. When used on a ragdolled target, attempt an armbar then do 3 hammer fists to the target’s head. 2.6, 9.2 (11.8 total) base damage on standing players, 2.6, 2.7x2, 5.4 (13.4) base damage on ragdolled players. 33s cooldown on miss, 41s cooldown on hit. Inflicts 1 cut on target.

![giphy.gif](https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMTV2ODZyZmJwbWFjYnY4bDJqNXYxbGZ4enhxeWNwZGRvOWc2YWdtayZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/SngWdBpXBCtKjSafe7/giphy.gif)

Taught by [[RVZ2KNgz]] if you meet the requirements.

Increases muscle scaling by 15%, strength scaling by 12.5%, health by 15%, and heals 25% of your health on activation. Last basic attack now inflicts bleed for 5 seconds. Drains .25% hunger per second, increases stamina consumption by 20%. Lasts 45 seconds, 5 minute cooldown.

Blast Core: A charged up attack that explodes with power. Guardbreaks. 15 base damage and 2.5% true damage, 1.2 second stun, 40 second cooldown. Increases Rib bone breaking count by 3.

![giphy.gif](https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbDZ6bmlsbjQybjlwMzJ5amQ2cG85ZzhtZWQ4Zmp1cmU4c2dhc3ZjcCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/MFGS1MtXMHE49sE6wt/giphy.gif)

cards.name: Half/Full Advance
cards.desc:
Half-Advance and Full-Advance are taught by [[VRkKjuGk]]. Half-Advance can be learned by anyone regardless of their clan, but Full-Advance can only be taught to Tokita clan members.

**Half-Advance:**

Attack speed increased by 10%. Run speed increased by 10%. Dashes go 10% farther and dash cooldowns are reduced by 25%. Basic and heavy attacks deal 15% more damage, but skills do 10% less damage. 20% Agility scaling and 10% Strength buff. Evasive charges 5% faster.

Damage taken is increased by 2% and  stamina drain is increased by 3% for each heart injury you have. If you get knocked out while the mode is active, you automatically get executed. Gains 1 Heart Injury count every 20 seconds.

![giphy.gif](https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZmNqcGJ4Y2FwZjE4bWh0YnIwcjYyZGdiOHRlM2F3NzNoOTI5bHkydiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/RagKAiA5z8oa6loLLi/giphy.gif)

---

**Full Advance:**

Attack speed is increased by 20%. Run speed is increased by 12.5%. Dashes go 15% farther and dash cooldowns are reduced by 33%. Basic and heavy attacks deal 20% more damage, but skills do 15% less damage. 30% Agility scaling and 15% Strength scaling buff. Evasive charges 10% faster.

Damage taken is increased by 3% and  stamina drain is increased by 3% for each heart injury you have. Bleed damage is 50% stronger on you. If you get knocked out while the mode is active, you automatically get executed. Gains 1 Heart Injury count every 15 seconds.

![giphy.gif](https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdHJkejhqOWt0enZ3d3E3MG5hNzYyOWpwNWc5MWF2MnNvamJvajZzdCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/glt2EZcOso7u5VuZP7/giphy.gif)

cards.name: Makunouchi Boxing (Makunouchi)
cards.desc:
Taught by [[GEIS9j0c]] for Makunouchi clan members.

Dempsey Roll: A long counter, weaving your enemy and pummeling them. 2x7 base damage, 5 base damage on last hit, 1.7 second ragdoll, 40 second miss cooldown, 150 second hit cooldown.

![giphy.gif](https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdHdycXgzemlyZmJ2aDl1dTdjeHUxaHhlc21vNDVuazVwaXZrMXp5ZiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/9nVVWfJTWo9vvYy7oR/giphy.gif)

Diagonal Dempsey Roll: An upgraded version of Dempsey Roll. 3.2 base damage first punch, 2.7 base damage second punch, .9x9 damage in rapid punches, 8.1 base damage on final punch (22.1 total), 1.7s stun, 59s cooldown on miss, 90s cooldown on hit, 1s counter window.

![giphy.gif](https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExamJlMWpid3p3NHFzbXZqYWplMjE1YWc5NjI2MWI3bGw2Y2RsOHJqdiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/tZxBUIqOgrcYwbwry1/giphy.gif)

Jab > 3-4-3-6 Combination: Multiple rapid punches that slightly move you forward. 3.1 base damage, 1.15s stun, 21s cooldown. Inflicts 1 rib breaking count

![giphy.gif](https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExd3Jod2d4Y2NieXprbDg0NXZ2Z3MyM3lrZzF6NHN0ODNnZ2liNmN6NSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/eGVQTQ72Ihb3fBtsOJ/giphy.gif)

Gazelle Punch > Explosive Gazelle Punch: Rush forward then uppercut. 9.8 base damage, 1s stun, 32s cooldown. Stops target’s running for 5 seconds, pauses their stamina regeneration for 3 seconds, and drains 7.5% of their stamina.

![giphy.gif](https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOGV4bXZqeXljZTk1aGF3MW9ud3VhcWN3NXY0OWc5MDNvdmdwYTVyMyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/a3T1slJap77IYMdVLD/giphy.gif)

Corkscrew Punch > Ten CM / Sakki: Close range is Ten CM, long range is Sakki. Ten CM throws a body uppercut. Sakki punches fast a shadow appears in front of you mimicking your movement. Ten CM has 14.4 base damage, 1.4s stun, 34s cooldown, inflicts 1 rib breaking count, and guardbreaks. Sakki has 6.8 base damage, 1s stun, 34s cooldown, and forces them to block for 2 seconds.

![giphy.gif](https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExamR6NHRoaHR6c2xvbnNyc3RudXkyYjk3Znd1a2xvMzVocWRvZmpiYyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/FaHWUHuoFF0YARuhNF/giphy.gif)

![giphy.gif](https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExY2dpenc2cWhtZ3E2eHV2Z3FpZGdwaHE1dTVzaDgzajBjZWpoNWZ4MyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/JbMn1i3Eq4LQBhQpxb/giphy.gif)

Weave > Rolling Blow: Dodge and counter attack your opponents attack. .45s counter window, 1s stun, 22s cooldown on miss, 27s cooldown on hit, inflicts 2 rib breaking counts.

![giphy.gif](https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNGwxN3BreDRyd3R5MGNyaDQ5Y3I1eDB1aHcybTk0ODI1d2p3NDBxaSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/ma4eiUFqnCpzcEgRTF/giphy.gif)

cards.name: Guihun (Wu)
cards.desc:
Guihun starts at 100%, giving a 15% damage buff, 12.5% health buff, 10% muscle scaling buff, and heals 27.5% on activation. Stamina consumption is increased by 25%. Lasts for 50 seconds.

You can increase your Guihun percentage by defeating Edward Wu.

Each 1% increases damage by .75%, health by .25%, and muscle by .75%. Caps at 110%.

110% Guihun: 20% damage buff, 17.5% health buff, 20% muscle scaling buff.

![giphy.gif](https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMTVob3Zxam81bXJqZTY5eGFvcDh5b2w3d3l5cmgweTJ4Y3gwbjdoMiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/EMfBvKCqtSlVKOW3qy/giphy.gif)

## Bus Stops

You can find bus stops spread throughout the city, going up to one of these and selecting them pulls up a menu to choose which stop you want to go to. The price increases the farther away the stop is.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/672c26cf77f128a213e08b8d/attachments/680becf14ea4dd7ce45cfb02/download/image.png)

cards.name: Special Accessories
cards.desc:
Accessories can be bought in [[vqRMEi5f]], the list of accessories rotate every hour. Talk to Aforaf on the second floor to buy and equip accessories.

You can also buy a random accessory for 25 Ryujin Coins in the shop.

These are just **purely cosmetic**, and provide **no boosts** to anything.

---

You can position certain accessories in different spots, different accessories have different positions available. In order to change the position, select the “Random Unique Accessory Position” option in the Ryujin Coin shop and choose what accessory you want to change.

cards.name: Psyche Info
cards.desc:
Different psyche storage slots have different psyche pities, and do not transfer between storage slots. Meaning if you get 174 pity on slot one and transfer to slot two, you will not have 174 pity on slot two.

If your damage buff from Psyches + Cards gets above 20%, then any buffs past that will be halved.

You can not have more than two of one psyche at the same time. Some psyches will only allow for one of that psyche. If you are unable to stack any more of a certain type of psyche, then you will also be unable to roll for it anymore.

Single Pysches (Can’t get more than one of): Indomitable Will, Hemorrhage, Battle Scars, Prodigy, Martyr, Savant, Genius Mentor, Principal, Kinesthetic Learner, Pain Resistant, Impatient, Menace, Berserker, Tough Skin, Last Stand, Dracula, Indefatigable, Unyielding, Lucky, Depraved, Combatant, Diehard, Grinder, Battle Knowledge, Honed Reflexes.

You can not have more than 2 psyches from the following groups of psyches:

Muscle Pysches: Muscle Man, Bodybuilder.

Damage Psyches: Savant, Sadist, Battle Scars, Berserk, Glass Cannon, Aggressive, Brawler, Glutton.

Mode Extending Psyches: Tiger Vessel, Perfected Vessel

Speed Psyches: Speed Surge, Psychopath, Scaredy Cat, Agile, Savior.

cards.name: How Cards Work
cards.desc:
Cards are an additional type of passive that effect specific skills for fighting styles, buffing them in various ways.

You can only get the card for the fighting style you have, getting a new card for each 25% your progress in Style Mastery. You can view your progress so the next card in the “Cards” tab in your inventory, appearing in the top right of the inventory menu. When you are able to get new cards, the symbol below will appear above your health bar. Once your mastery is full, you will have 4 cards in total. Increase your mastery by hitting anything, including players and punching bags.

For modes, you can get one card for every 50% Mode Mastery, which equals 1000 hits on another player while your mode is active. You can choose from 3 cards that pop up, and only have 2 cards per mode maximum.

You can gain Player Trait cards with any style, however it takes 4 times longer to get a card than a normal style.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/67255226a0f47512a7784741/attachments/672c76bf72a1e7fadc0e6088/download/image.png)

Clicking on this symbol will give you a choice between 4 cards. You can only choose one of these cards to keep for this fighting style.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/67255226a0f47512a7784741/attachments/67ba7746fb25c82dfb02ac46/download/image.png)

‌

You can choose to select the cards later and hide them by clicking the symbol again. This will not refresh the cards you can choose from, just lets you choose them later.

Your cards save with each fighting style and mode, so if you change fighting styles or clan you can get new cards while still keeping the cards you had. You do not have to reset the cards for your previous style to get new cards for your new style.

If you get a card for a skill then it will always apply to that skill, no matter what your style is. For example, you can use Boxing’s Heart Twist while having Taekwondo style.

You can reroll your cards with [[syEIVzBQ]].

The chances for each rarity are as follows: 60% Common, 30% Rare, 9% Legendary, 1% Mythic.

If your damage buff from Psyches + Cards gets above 20%, then any buffs past that will be halved.

cards.name: Quest Board
cards.desc:
You can spawn enemies by taking a quest off of the Quest Board found around the map.

Spawned NPCs scale off your stats:

- Thug: 115% of your stats
- Thug Leader: 225%
- Mafia: 140%
- Capo: 250%

## Quests

Defeat Thugs (Rank E-)

- 3-7 Thugs, 75s per Thug, 3 min cooldown
- Per NPC: ₩2,500, 1 STR, 0.5 BS, 0.5 DUR

Defeat Mafia (Rank C)

- 3-7 Mafia, 90s each, 5 min cooldown
- Per NPC: ₩5,000, 1.5 STR, 1 BS, 1 DUR

Defeat Thugs Leader (Rank B)

- 1-2 Leaders, 120s each, 15 min cooldown
- Per NPC: ₩40,000, 5 RC, 5 STR, 2.5 BS, 1.5 DUR

Defeat Capo (Rank A)

- 1-2 Capos, 150s each, 20 min cooldown
- Per NPC: ₩75,000, 10 RC, 6 STR, 4 BS, 2.5 DUR

Defeat Thugs (Boss Quest) (Rank X)

- 60 min total time limit, 30 min cooldown
- Rewards: 15 RC, 2 Psyche Shard Pieces, 30-min 10% XP Boost

cards.name: Removal (Kure)
cards.desc:
Taught by [[2zCzYcde]].

Base: 10% more damage, 10% more health, lasts 30 seconds, and consume 20% more stamina.

Each percent between **0-50%** increases the **damage** buff by **.15%** and **health** buff by **.04%.** (17.5% dmg 12% health at 50%)

Each percent between **51-80%** increases the **damage** buff by **.25%** and **health** buff by **.08%** (22.5% dmg and 14.4% health at 80%)

Each percent between **81-100%** increases **damage** buff by **.375%** and **health** buff by **.155%.** (30% dmg and 17.5% health at 100%)

**20%** Removal requires X- Rank (20000 total stats).
**40%** Removal requires XX- Rank (32000 total stats).
**50%** Removal requires XXX- Rank (50000 total stats), increases time to 40 seconds.
**70%** Removal requires Z- Rank (80000 total stats).
**80%** Removal requires ZZ- Rank (125000 total stats).
**90%** Removal requires ZZ Rank (145000 total stats).
**100%** Removal requires ZZ+ Rank (165000 total stats), increases time to 50 seconds.

cards.name: Uncommon Accessories
cards.desc:
Accessories can be bought in [[vqRMEi5f]], the list of accessories rotate every hour. Talk to Aforaf on the second floor to buy and equip accessories.

You can also buy a random accessory for 25 Ryujin Coins in the shop.

These are just **purely cosmetic**, and provide **no boosts** to anything.

---

You can position certain accessories in different spots, different accessories have different positions available. In order to change the position, select the “Random Unique Accessory Position” option in the Ryujin Coin shop and choose what accessory you want to change.

These are just **purely cosmetic**, and provide **no boosts** to anything.

---

You can position certain accessories in different spots, different accessories have different positions available. In order to change the position, select the “Random Unique Accessory Position” option in the Ryujin Coin shop and choose what accessory you want to change.

cards.name: Trainings
cards.desc:
## Training Equipment

---

Boxing Gloves: Found in [[tRsu8u0y]], [[7IIgJeY8]], and [[DIj1BvAr]] for **₩1,750**, increases the **Strength** xp gained from punching bags.

Breathing Mask: Found in [[IRmuFhpO]] for **₩5,000**, gives user **Stamina** experience when running while equipped but halves Stamina regeneration.

Blindfold: Found in [[vqRMEi5f]] for **₩5,000**, boosts **Battle Sense** gain by 50% while worn, but puts user at 150% blindness.

Vests: Found in [[IRmuFhpO]] in 5kg, 10kg, 20kg, and 50kg options. Prices for each go by **₩1,500**, **₩3,500**, **₩10,000**, and **₩30,000** respectively. Will increase gains for **Stamina** by the weight amount (50kg is a 50% boost) and **Durability** by a quarter of the weight (50kg is a 12.5% boost) while equipped. Increases Strength gained from pushups by Vest Weight / 4, meaning 12.5% more Strength per pushup at 50kg. To use properly you need the one third of the amount of Upper Muscle in pounds as the weights are in KG. Dashing requires 70% of the muscle requirement. For example, 50kg Vest requires an additional 17 pounds of muscle from base (17 pounds), totaling 34lbs Upper Muscle to move freely with 50kg vest, and 29lbs to dash with it.

Leg Weights: Found in [[IRmuFhpO]] in 5kg, 10kg, 20kg, and 50kg options. Prices for each go by **₩750**, **₩2,000**, **₩5,000**, and **₩20,000** respectively. Will increase gains for **Agility** while equipped by the weight amount (50kg is a 50% boost), slows down user based on the Lower Muscle stat in the same way as Vests.

Muscle Inhibitor: Found in [[GjlL9ltg]]for ₩25,000. Using the Muscle Inhibitor will stop all muscle gain, allowing you to do trainings without gaining muscle anymore. To get rid of Muscle Inhibitor's effect, use the inhibitor again and you will start gaining muscles again.

## Training Methods

---

Jumping Jacks: Found in [[XXfZ2G0d]] for **₩1,000**, prompts user to press buttons to train .05 Agility and .015 Lower Muscle.

Squat: Found in [[DIj1BvAr]] and [[ANNcOig5]] for **₩1,000**, prompts user to press the button when the circle is inside the prompt to train .1 Agility and .035 Lower Muscle.

Pushup: Found in [[DIj1BvAr]] and [[ANNcOig5]] for **₩1,000**, click to train .03 Strength and .08 Upper Muscle. Wear Vests to increase Strength gained per pushup.

One Handed Pushup: Found in [[XXfZ2G0d]] for **₩2,250**, prompts the user to press the button that shows up to train .07 Strength and .06 Upper Muscle.

Handstand Pushup: Found in [[ANNcOig5]] for **₩5,000**. Prompts the user to press the button when the circle is inside the prompt to train .14 Strength and .08 Upper Muscle.

Kettlebell Pistol Squat: Found in [[DIj1BvAr]]. Gives .1 Agility, .12 Strength, and .12 Lower Muscle per use.

Punching Bags: found in  [[DIj1BvAr]] and [[GFo1s7Ah]], punching them trains Strength. Wear Boxing Gloves to greatly increase the amount of Strength gained (.035 Strength with gloves, .001 Strength without).

Durability Training: Found in [[DIj1BvAr]] and [[ANNcOig5]]for **₩750**, if hit while active user will gain Durability scaling off of how much damage they do to you, up to .0275 at 6.5% damage per hit.

Striking Logs: Found in [[ANNcOig5]], punching a striking log will damage you based on your Strength, training your Durability scaling off of how much damage you do to yourself.

Situp: Found in [[DIj1BvAr]] and [[ANNcOig5]]for **₩1,000**, prompts user to press buttons to train .115 Durability and .012 Upper Muscle.

Bicycle Crunches: Found in [[DIj1BvAr]]. Gives .11 Durability, .1 Stamina, and .08 Upper Muscle per use.

Jumping Rope: Found in [[XXfZ2G0d]] for **₩1,250**, prompts the user to press buttons to train .1224Stamina and .06 Lower and Upper Muscle.

Roadworks: Bought from [[ATADSZH2]], Short Roadworks cost **₩1,500** and Long Roadworks cost **₩4,000**. Finishing a short roadwork gives 3 Agility, 6 Stamina, .01 Upper Muscle, and .075 Lower Muscle. Long roadworks do 12 Agility, 12.8 Stamina, .025 Upper Muscle, and .125 Lower Muscle.

Speedball: Found in Kevin Box. Costs ₩50 per use, or free if you have a Gym Subscription. Gives .125 Agility and .05 Battle Sense per use.

Boulder Pulling: Found in [[lkVkiiXs]] for **₩2,000** each boulder, pull to the target area to train Strength, Stamina, Upper Muscle, and Lower Muscle. Pull speed changes with height and weight.

Shadow Boxing: Bought from [[ANNcOig5]] for **₩2,500**, spawns shadows around the user that will attack if not hit. Hitting a shadow gives .02 Battle Sense experience per hit and makes it go away.

Pattern Training: Bought from [[DIj1BvAr]] for **₩2,500**, shows a pattern the user has to memorize and then perform. Gives 0.25 Battle Sense per pattern, 4 patterns per training session.

## Gym Trainings

---

Gym Trainings are found inside of [[DIj1BvAr]], with a couple also being purchase for gang bases. Each rep of a training will cost ₩50, or if you buy a Gym Subscription from [[ATADSZH2]] then you can use the trainings for free as long as your subscription is active.

Each weight decreases that Stat gain by .0075, but increases the Muscle gain by .03. For example, no weight on Bench Press is .125 Strength and .13 Upper Muscle, while the max weight gives .1025 Strength and .22 Upper Muscle.

Treadmills: Can be bought for [[d1iIdwKM]]. Prompts user to press the buttons that appear. Gives .26 Agility and .05 Lower Muscle each use.

Pullups: Can be bought for [[d1iIdwKM]]. Prompts user to press the buttons that appear. Gives .48 Stamina and .07 Upper Muscle.

Bench Press: Prompts user to press the buttons that appear. Gives .14 Strength and .15 Upper Muscle at base gains.

Barbell Squats: Prompts the user to press the buttons that appear. Gives .13 Agility and .13 Lower Muscle at base gains.

Triggers when you go below 50% health. ON activation knocks back all surrounding enemies and covers you in steam. Fat movement speed and attack speed debuffs are reduced by 50%. cards.name: Soft Caps
cards.desc:
Soft Caps are thresholds at which the amount of experience you gained is decreased by a certain amount, making it harder to progress as you get stronger.

These caps only apply when a stat crosses the threshold, if your Strength is at 2750 and your Stamina is at 725 then you will have 70% Strength gain and 90% Stamina gain.

## Stat Gains:

- 725 (C): 90% Gain
- 1245 (B): 80% Gain
- 2750 (A): 70% Gain
- 4200 (S-): 55% Gain
- 7200 (SS): 45% Gain
- 10000 (SS+): 30% Gain
- 12500 (SSS-): 25% Gain
- 17500 (SSS+): 10% Gain
- 28000 (X+): 7.5% Gain
- 50000 (XXX-): 2.5% Gain

---

## Muscle Gains

- 33: 75% Gain
- 66: 50% Gain
- 116: 30% Gain
- 166: 25% Gain
- 250: 12.5% Gain
- 333: 5% Gain
- 500: 2.5% Gain
- 666: 1% Gain
- 750: .5% Gain
- 1000+: .33% Gain

---

Stat effectiveness is how much your stat actually increases your amounts, for example 2 points in Strength from 8700-12500 is only as effective as 1 point in Strength from 0-4200.

## Strength/Durability Effectiveness:

- 4200 (S-): 80% Effectiveness, 7800 effective stat in total by 8700.
- 8700 (SS): 50% Effectiveness, 9700 effective stat in total by 12500.
- 12500 (SSS-): 35% Effectiveness, 12325 effective stat in total by 20000.
- 20000 (X-): 20% Effectiveness, 14725 effective stat in total by 32000.
- **Strength Only -** 32000 (XX-): 10% Effectiveness, 19525 effective stat in total by 80000.
- **Durability Only** - 32000 (XX-): 15% Effectiveness, 21925 effective stat in total by 80000.
- **Strength Only -** 80000+ (Z-): 7.5% Effectiveness.

The following scalings affect only your damage gains from the respective stats. **Your actual Agility and Stamina will not become less effective**, only your damage from them will be.

## Agility Effectiveness:

- 4200 (S-): 75% Effectiveness, 7575 effective stat in total by 8700.
- 8700 (SS): 45% Effectiveness, 9285 effective stat in total by 12500.
- 12500 (SSS-): 25% Effectiveness, 11160 effective stat in total by 20000.
- 20000 (X-): 15% Effectiveness, 12960 effective stat in total by 32000.
- 32000 (XX-): 7.5% Effectiveness, 16560 effective stat in total by 80000.
- 80000+ (Z-): 5% Effectiveness.

## Stamina/Battle Sense Effectiveness:

- 4200 (S-): 70% Effectiveness, 7350 effective stat in total by 8700.
- 8700 (SS-): 40% Effectiveness, 8870 effective stat in total by 12500.
- 12500 (SSS-): 20% Effectiveness, 10370 effective stat in total by 20000.
- 20000 (X-): 10% Effectiveness, 11570 effective stat in total by 32000.
- 32000 (XX-): 5% Effectiveness, 13970 effective stat in total by 80000.
- 80000+ (Z-): 3.5% Effectiveness.

---

Muscle effectiveness only applies once a certain muscle reaches the number, if you have 800 Upper muscle and 200 Lower muscle then only Upper Muscle is effected by any scaling changes.

## Muscle Effectiveness:

- 166: 65% Effectiveness, 220 effective muscle in total by 250
- 250: 40% Effectiveness, 254 effective muscle in total by 333
- 333: 20% Effectiveness, 320 effective muscle in total by 666
- 666: 15% Effectiveness, 370 effective muscle in total by 1000
- 1000: 10% Effectiveness, 420 effective muscle in total by 1500
- 1500+: 7.5% Effectiveness

---

Mission Softcaps are the softcaps that apply to your Mission rewards, they do not go through Stat Gain softcaps and are only affected by the Mission softcaps.

These softcaps only apply for your individual stats, if you have 4200 Strength and 12500 Stamina then you will get 80% of the Strength reward and 50% of the Stamina reward.

## Mission Rewards:

- 4200 (S-): 90% gain.
- 12500 (SSS-): 70% gain.
- 20000 (X-): 45% gain.
- 32000 (XX-): 25% gain.
- 50000 (XXX-): 15% gain.
- 80000 (Z-): 5% gain
- 110000 (Z+): 2% gain
- 145000 (ZZ): .75% gain

cards.name: Gangs
cards.desc:
To create a gang, talk to [[BxoZG3EF]].

You must have a minimum Potential of SS- to join a gang, otherwise you will be deemed too weak.

Open up the gang menu in the top left to view your gang. Gang leaders can invite people, kick someone, transfer leadership, or disband the gang from this menu. You do not have to be in the same server as someone to invite, kick, or transfer to them.

Gangs can be levelled up to increase the amount of members you can have, and the facilities inside of your [[d1iIdwKM]]. To level up your gang, interact with the [[CpcOPLTl]] system inside of the gang base. **Only the leader and officers can level up gangs**.

## Ranks:

The Gang Leader can change the name of the following ranks, however their permissions are still the same.

- Gang Leader: Can do everything.
- Officer: Can invite, kick people, and upgrade the gang.
- Recruiter: Can invite people to the gang.
- Member: Basic gang member, no special perms.

## Levels:

Money and stats come from the gang leader.

- Level 1 (Base):  SS- Potential, 1m money or 100 RC. 15 members.
- Level 2: SSS- Potential, 2.5m money or 250 RC. 30 members.
- Level 3: X- Potential, 5m money or 500 RC. 60 members.
- Level 4: XX- Potential, 7.5m money or 750 RC. 100 members.
- Level 5 (Max): XXX- Potential, 10m money or 1000 RC. 150 members.

cards.name: Mythic (1%)
cards.desc:
You are guaranteed a Mythic Clan after 175 clan spins, unless you get a Mythic before then.

‌

- Park: Can copy up to 2 skills (20s cooldown). Copied skills stay for 60 seconds or until you use it, whichever happens first, and deal more damage than if you were to use it yourself. Deal 5% more damage for 10 seconds after using a copied skill. Cooldowns are reduced by 7.5%. Lean Cap is increased by 10 Fat and 22 Total Muscle. Battle Sense scales 50% better. Fighting Reflexes charge 20% faster. Mode Bar charges 20% faster. Stat gained increased by 20%. Battle Sense gain is increased by 25% more. Can learn [[64maoxAh]] mode.
- Kure: Recover .5% of your hunger when hitting someone, eating meaty food gives 25% more hunger. Increases stat gain by 20%. Strength scaling is increased by 15% and Durability scaling is increased by 10%. Can learn [[H1c4lHJq]] and [[2CMXUZ56]].
- Mikazuchi: Dash cooldowns are .4 seconds shorter and consume 25% less stamina. Agility scaling is increased by 20%. Run speed is increased by 10%. Evasive charges up 7.5% faster, and your evasive now teleports you 20 studs backwards. Stat gains are increased by 20%. Can learn [[ilbDoTCs]] and [[d5kudolc]].
- Tokita: Strength scaling is increased by 10%. Agility scaling is increased by 10%. Locked In stats change twice as fast. Mode bar fills up 15% faster. Heart Injuries require 2 more counts. Stat gain is increased by 20%. Can learn [[Bka5Tk9E]] and [[veP2kxsW]].
- Hanma: Muscle gain is increased by 20%. Muscle scaling is increased by 15% (only works if not lean). Durability scaling is increased by 10%. Stat gain is increased by 20%. Grab attacks lower enemy damage by 5% for 10 seconds. Lean cap is increased by 10%. Can learn [[8FO6whSl]], [[ioIQOZu0]], and [[QtWEp2rt]].
- Jiu: 2 more max scars. Stat gain is increased by 20%. Injuries, cuts, and low health debuffs are decreased by 20%. Gain 1.5% strength effectiveness and movement speed per scar. Gain 1.5% crit rate and 2.5% crit damage per scar. Your Fighting Reflex is locked to Lean, and charges 10% faster. 20% more grip damage. While below 50% health, gain 0.75% damage reduction and 1% damage buff per scar. Can learn [[HwrJdydC]], and [[gfEJuMBG]] mode.

cards.name: Mythics (.5%)
cards.desc:
- Monopoly : 50% more money from all sources.
- Perfected Vessel: Modes last 50% longer. Mode Bar charges 33% faster.
- Honed Reflexes: Fighting Reflexes charge 33% faster.
- Hemorrhage:  Effects that deal damage over time last for 50% longer.
- Battle Scars: Each scar you have increases damage by 3%, up to 15%. Injury debuffs are decreased by 25%.
- Prodigy: Can learn pure skills with only 3 style skills.
- Iron Mountain: Your block now protects you from all directions. Guard breaks stun you for 12.5% less, and you take 15% less damage while guard broken. Holding block drains stamina by 2% per second.
- Savant: Style Mastery buff is increased by 15%, but skills do 20% less damage.
- Genius Mentor: Your XP boost from each disciple is increased to 5%. Disciples boost per rank difference is increased to 4%.
- Indefatigable: Stamina consumption is reduced by 33%, poise activates 1 hit earlier. Poise gain is increased by .02.
- Dracula Heal 50% of the DoT you deal.
- Last Stand: When hit by an attack that would normally down you, your health is set to 1 and you take no damage for 10 seconds. Damage increased by 20% for the duration. Once duration ends you are knocked down.
- Battle Knowledge: Being hit while blocking charges evasive 20% faster. Using Evasive heals 3.5% health and recovers 12.5% stamina.

cards.name: Boss Info
cards.desc:
Bosses are powerful fightable NPCs that spawn in designated spots around the map. When one pops up there will be a message indicating which boss appeared, while nearby players will see a cutscene for the boss.

You can only enter a boss arena when a boss is there if you are past X- Rank (20,000 Total Power).

Bosses spawn naturally every 1.5-2.5 hours, or you can spawn one early by using an Essence, bought from [[5yagqsub]]for ₩5,000,000. When spawned through an Essence, the respawn timer for the boss respawn resets.

These bosses are not designed to be soloable, it is recommended to get some friends to help you fight against them.

Bosses have different rewards that can be found in the specific bosses' card, including Ryujin Coins, Won, XP Boosts, and Skill requirements.

To be eligible for rewards from a boss, you must deal at least 15% of the bosses' health. The person who dealt the most damage will receive 2 random rewards from defeating the boss instead of one.

If a clan specific reward appears it will show up on the ground for anyone to claim, disappearing after 5 minutes if nobody takes it. Must have done at least 10% damage in order to claim the item.

There is a 30 minute cooldown before you can get rewards from the same boss after defeating them. If you manually spawn a boss with their Essence, then this cooldown is ignored and you can get rewards from them.

When a boss has not been attacked for 45 seconds then they start healing at a rate of 0.5% health per second, and all damage contributions decrease by 0.5% per second.

For each player that joins in the fight, the bosses health goes up by 100,000 (up to 10 players, where the health increases by 1,000,000).

cards.name: Thugs
cards.desc:
Thugs are a low level enemy that will appear when a player accepts a quest from the [[2t6FwSNV]] .

Thugs get a bit stronger as the player gets stronger, up until they reach SSS rank. They will stop spawning once you pass XX rank.

When defeated, thugs have a 50% chance to drop money. The money goes up as the thugs get stronger, capping at ₩10,000.

cards.name: Twister (Name/Title Changer/Darkness Blow)
cards.desc:
Found in [[j6nbtF2H]], lets you change your name for **₩25,000** or your Title for **30 Ryujin Coins** if you have at least **XX Potential**. To equip your title go to [[vqRMEi5f]] second floor.

Also teaches Darkness Blow to people in the Sta clan. To learn you must first land 250 critical hits.

cards.name: Stats
cards.desc:
## Stat Info:

- **Potential:** A representation of your total power. Your potential is based off of your Strength, Durability, Stamina, Agility, and Battle Sense all being added together. When combined, your potential will be the rank that matches the total amount of power. Each increase in Potential rewards some Ryujin Coins. View stat ranks below.
- **Strength**: Increases damage for styles, to view specific increases check the Style information to the list on the right. Increases stamina drain when attacking. Fight people or use Punching Bags and Pushups to train.
- **Durability**: Increases your health by Durability\*8.5, meaning at 100 Durability you will have 700 health and at 200 Durability you have 1300 health. Lowers your fatigue gain as Durability increases by FatigueGain\*.75^(Durability/4500). Decreases Mode fatigue by 40% at 16,666 Durability. Get hit by people or use Durability Training, Striking Posts, or Situps to train.
- **Stamina**: Increases your stamina by 1 per Stamina. Lowers your fatigue gain as Stamina increases by FatigueGain\*.75^(Stamina/4500). Decreases Mode fatigue by 40% at 16,666 Stamina. Decreases running and dashing stamina drain from 2.5% to 1% at 20,000 Stamina (Stamina/20000\*.015). Drain your stamina or do Roadworks to train or wear a Breathing Mask to gain Stamina from running.
- **Agility**: Increases your running speed, maxes at 600 Agility. [[0Omc9gsc]] allow you to increase the maximum. Makes attacks faster, maxing at 4,500 Agility.  Your runspeed is lowered by 1 every 50 Total Muscles or 33 Fat you have above lean cap, whichever would lower your speed more is the one applied. Above 166 TM from base your attack speed is lowered by AttackSpeed*(1/(2^((TM-166)/2500))), capping at half speed at 666 TM. Run around or use Squats or do Roadworks to train.
- **Battle Sense (BS)**: Increases your [[ZuFBEdwu]] charge rate, starting at 100 BS and maxing at 1500 BS, and widens your perfect block window, capping at 1500 BS. Multiplies Mode duration by BS/2500, capping at 2.5x more (3750 BS). Gained by fighting other players, using Shadow Boxing, or doing Rayleigh’s quest.
- **Upper Muscle (UM)**: _All numbers do not include base muscles (17), so 100 in this case means 117 in game._ Acts as a multiplier for upper style damages. Increases health by UM/333*1.2, capping at 12.5% more health at 208 UM. Also increases your stamina consumption for Upper Muscle attacks by UM/3 when below 66 UM, and UM/1 when above and at 66 UM. Use Jumping Ropes, Situps, Squats, or Pushups to train. Eat fat-giving food, starve yourself, or talk to [[ABXLSWi2]] to lose muscles. Muscle is capped at 4,000 **Total Muscle**.
- **Lower Muscle (LM)**: _All numbers do not include base muscles (17), so 100 in this case means 117 in game._ Acts as a multiplier for lower style damages. Increases health by LM/333*1.2, capping at 12.5% more health at 208 LM.  Increases stamina consumption for lower muscle attacks by LM/10 below 66 LM, and LM/3 when above and at 66 LM. Increases stamina consumption for running by (LM/100)/100 x Stamina, maxing out at 100 LM where it drains 1% of your stamina per second. Once you pass 66 LM your dash goes farther. Every 33 LM past 66 increases your dash distance by 5%, up to 25% more at 233 LM. Do Roadworks. Jumping Jacks, or Squats to train. Eat fat-giving food, starve yourself, or talk to [[ABXLSWi2]] to lose muscles. Muscle is capped at 4,000 **Total Muscle**.
- **Muscle Memory**: Your highest muscle gained so far. If your muscle falls below this amount, then your muscle gain is increased by 150% (2.5x) and all muscle gain softcaps are ignored until you reach it again. Only applies to each muscle individually, having less Lower Muscle than your Upper Muscle Memory does not affect anything.
- **Fat**: _All numbers do not include base fat (32), so 100 in this case means 132 in game._ Gained by eating junk food when already full on hunger. The more fat you have, the more health you have up to 35% more and your attacks do more damage up to 60% more. However, your attacks also become slower. At 150 Fat your dashes are 15% longer, and at 300 they are 25% longer. Your attack hitbox gets wider the fatter you are. As your fat increases your muscle gain is lowered, up to 90% less muscle gain at 500 fat. The maximum amount of fat is 532 pounds, lowered by 1 every 1.6 muscle you have past 167 Total Muscle up to 400 lower, capping it at 132 pounds with 800 total muscle. Cap can be raised with certain clans. Eat a lot of fat-giving food to gain fat, eat a Protein Bar and do trainings, run while wearing a Breathing Mask, or talk to [[ABXLSWi2]] to lose fat.
- **Height**: Randomly given when you create your character, can be changed by spending Robux or with ₩20,000 through [[AqTOqieq]]. Check the boosts you get from height in [[5yDPA0p9]].
- **Bounty/Fame**: Bounty and Fame are gained through various actions, bounty through crimes and Fame through hunting down high Bounty targets. To check boosts, go to [[bmQSA7Tv]] and [[Y3D01k1E]].

cards.name: Game Mechanics
cards.desc:
**Combat Tag** is applied when you are attacked by another player. While Combat Tag is applied, your health no longer regenerates, and being gripped will make you lost all your bought tools. If you leave while the Combat Tag is active it will count as a combat log, causing you to lose 33% of your current Won and all of the temporary items you bought. Things like Phones and Remove Skill Tokens will save. Combat Tag lasts for 30 seconds normally, can be shortened with some Psyches.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/6736862e5405edaded9652bd/attachments/6738053ba1a68db05d9a70d0/download/image.png)

‌

**Fatigue** is gained while training, running, and using skills. You can view your fatigue by hovering over your stamina bar. Over time your fatigue gradually builds up, and when it reaches 90% you will no longer be able to train and your screen will darken a bit, unless you own a Psyche that grants you immunity. Additionally, you will also drain more stamina as your fatigue increases, up to 25% more at 100% fatigue. Decrease fatigue gain by increasing Stamina and Durability, each lowering your gain by 25% every 4,000 Stamina or Durability. This means you can have 25% Fatigue gain when both are at 10,000. You can lower fatigue by laying in a bed in the [[GjlL9ltg]], or through massages at [[FDJPFzgZ]]. Fatigue goes away at a rate of 1% every 5 minutes you are offline.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/6736862e5405edaded9652bd/attachments/67380551b319237256e893b4/download/image.png)

**Hunger** is a resource that will drain over time, and can be replenished by buying and eating food at various stores like [[D8vR8Wiz]]  and [[VJ2cfx7F]]. When your hunger reaches 0% your stamina and health regeneration will decrease, taking longer to recover both. To view your specific hunger, hover over the yellow hunger bar below health and stamina.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/6736862e5405edaded9652bd/attachments/6738055b038ccced83fa98b9/download/image.png)

**Perfect Blocks** occur when you block and M1 right when someone hits you, a short period that increases as your Battle Sense increases. When you get a perfect block, the person attacking you will be stunned for a short while, allowing you to attack them.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/6736862e5405edaded9652bd/attachments/67380491db37396028dfed7a/download/image.png)

**Critical Hits** are attacks that do 33% bonus damage or more if you have a card that boosts them, available only for lean builds. When you have base fat and muscles, you have a 25% chance for a critical hit. Your critical chance is lowered the closer you get to your lean caps, and going past one or both of your caps removes critical hits entirely.

![critHit.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/6736862e5405edaded9652bd/attachments/6760e7c6ea870d56eb6d0f14/download/critHit.png)

**Gripping** is possible when you or someone else gets knocked out, either from running out of health or stamina. When you get knocked out and fall on the floor, someone can go up to and press the gripping button (default B) they will get on top of you and can start beating you up. Your health bar then changes to show how many hits you can take before dying while being gripped. You can grip people faster with more Agility, do more damage with more Strength, and take more hits with more Durability.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/6736862e5405edaded9652bd/attachments/673806576adc480aa1751c20/download/image.png)

**Evasion** is a mechanic unlocked by [[IfKzh70k]], allowing you to dodge an attack. You charge up your evasion by hitting others or getting hit, until the bar on the right fully fills up. Once full, press your evasion button (default R) and you will be able to escape from being stunned, dashing you away from the other player.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/6736862e5405edaded9652bd/attachments/6738062f7dd302128d346470/download/image.png)

**Style Mastery** is a representation of your proficiency with your fighting style. As you attack things using your style, your mastery continuously progresses, increasing the amount of damage you do and unlocking Cards, for Card info check [[2LYgYA1x]]. You can view your mastery progress by seeing how close you are to the next card, each card being 25% mastery. At max Style Mastery your damage is increased by 25%.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/6736862e5405edaded9652bd/attachments/674dfd2af9375567f1366322/download/image.png)

**Invincible Body** is a phenomenon that appears when someone’s Durability is 500 higher than your Strength. Once someone's Durability passes 1,000, you only need 25% of their Durability in Strength to hit them. When this occurs, hitting the other person will feel like hitting a wall, doing no damage to them and instead slightly hurting yourself based on how high their durability is.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/6736862e5405edaded9652bd/attachments/6736a35f01107359bb0be117/download/image.png)

**Aura** is a symbol of a strong player, only appearing on someone who has 2,500 more total stats than you do, or on anyone above 50,000 total stats. The aura surrounds the player, showing their strength to others. The color of your aura also shows up on your skills. This is purely cosmetic, and does not boost anything. You can toggle auras in the settings, choosing if you want to see your aura and other people’s auras.

![aura.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/6736862e5405edaded9652bd/attachments/6736a32f2b0c7c5a68dbafce/download/aura.png)

cards.name: In-Game Index
cards.desc:
The **Index** is an in-game, all-in-one encyclopedia that updates in real time as you progress. It gives 100% accurate live game data, so you don't have to rely on external sites for exact numbers.

You can find the Index by opening the menu (M key, or the 3 lines symbol in top left) and finding it in the second slot.

It covers:

- **Styles** - scalings, skills, cards
- **Stances** - scalings, skills
- **Style Trainers** - tracking, style requirements, skill requirements
- **Subskill Trainers** - tracking, requirements, skill descriptions
- **Clans** - evolution quests, clan descriptions
- **Psyches** - descriptions
- **Modes** - requirements, buffs, mode cards
- **Player** - stats explanation, player trait cards
- **Bosses** - movesets, psyches, cards, stats and health, how to spawn them
- **Height** - height benefits
- **Trainings** - training gains and costs

The Index also shows trainer names for styles and stances in the mini description (example: Kim Soohyun [Taekkyeon]).

cards.name: Getting Started
cards.desc:
To start off, all new players can only fight other weak players in similar strength until they reach a total of 4200 stats, or S- rank Potential, making them able to attack stronger players, but unable to attack weak players anymore. You also gain a 50% xp boost until 10,000 stats, or SS+ rank Potential.

To get money, you should find jobs on Job Boards around the city, pictured below. Take one of the jobs then complete them to get some money.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/672c2ad44c81b32333da138a/attachments/672c2b710baeffb642b628aa/download/image.png)

Once you have a decent amount of money, your first stop should be the [[IRmuFhpO]] to buy a breathing mask, allowing you to gain stamina experience while running. Stamina is the first stat you will want to increase, as it dictates how much you will be able to train and run around.

After getting a suitable amount of stamina, go to [[DIj1BvAr]] to purchase some trainings to help your stats. Train until you have enough stats to get a fighting style of your choice, then you are free to make your own build and fight others.

The first big purchase you should go for is a [[DIXjSrZS]], as this will allow you to see where locations are from anywhere, and grab jobs through the app. After getting a phone, go for a bank account at [[PivBTWDl]] to keep your money safe.

Your first unlock should be the Evasive, as it is an important mechanic that will help you in your fights, getting you out of combos. Go to [[IfKzh70k]] to learn it.

cards.name: How To Get Money
cards.desc:
There are various ways of getting money, from doing jobs to breaking things.

You can find job boards around the city which will give you short jobs to do that give a varying amount of money on completion. As your Employee Level increases you gain access to [[veBUaJcQ]], which give you a lot more money for working than normal jobs.

If you want to try to fight, you can find [[ArRsfq4L]] or [[dVuH8JBM]] in certain shady areas such as alleyways and the warehouse, and when you beat them they have a chance to drop some money.

To get the most money from fighting NPCs you can try fighting bosses, but that is recommended to be at least XXX rank to attempt with a group.

The best and riskiest way to gain money is from robbing other players, upon successfully robbing someone you will take 10% of their money that they are holding from them. To keep your money safe from being robbed, open a bank account at [[PivBTWDl]] and store your money.

Alternatively, other people can drop you money by clicking their money, and then typing the amount they want to drop on the box that pops up.

The current money cap is 50 million in the bank and 1,000,000 in your wallet.

cards.name: Injury Info
cards.desc:
All injuries can be healed by [[kvw4OJi9]] at the [[GjlL9ltg]].

**Blindness**: Blindness builds up gradually from certain skills like Gazelle Punch that damage your vision. As your blindness goes up, your screen will get blurrier and it will be harder to see things. Healing from maximum blindness costs ₩25,000. Can be healed manually with Eye Drops for ₩750 each.

**Scars**: Scars build up every time you get gripped, decreasing maximum health by 7% and lowering health and stamina regeneration by 5% per scar on the user. Maximum 5 scars.

**Cuts**: Cuts are a 1% chance from any hit, each cut slows down health regeneration by 2% and decreases total health by 1%. You can have up to 10 cuts, for a total of 20% slower regeneration and 10% less health. Bandaids can be bought at the [[GjlL9ltg]] which will recover 1 cut every 30 seconds. Any attack that would’ve been a cut instead destroys a bandaid if any are present.

**Broken Bones**: For a bone to break it must reach it’s bone break count limit (5 for Ribs and Jaw, 7 for Arms and Legs) from skills or critical hits. Every 20 seconds of no increase on count for that bone decreases it’s count by one. On critical hit there is a 50% chance to increase a random bone’s break count by one. One broken leg decreases runspeed by 20% and lowers dash distance by 12.5%. Two broken legs decreases runspeed by 40% aad dash distance by 27.5%. A broken arm decreases damage by 15% for each arm, one broken arm decreases attack speed by 20% and two broken arms decreases attack speed by 50%. A broken rib will reduce stamina regeneration by 10% and maixmum stamina by 5% per rib broken. A broken jaw adds a flat 33% blindness debuff. Maximum of 2 broken legs, 2 broken arms, 1 broken jaw, and 5 broken ribs.

**Heart**: Heart Injuries build up each time you reactivate your mode. Initial activation does not give any Heart Injuries. Each reactivation gives 3 injury counts, requiring a total of 5 counts in order to get one injury. Every 20 seconds of no count increase decreases the count by one. Each Heart Injury reduces your maximum health by 7.5%, lowers health regeneration by 15%, increases stamina drain by 5% and causes 1% true damage every 5 seconds. Maximum of four heart injuries.

cards.name: Locked In Training
cards.desc:
Locked in Training triggers when you pass 1000 training sessions for a single stat. You can view your current locked in stat and counter in the top right Primary Stat icon once you reach a 500 streak.

If a training does multiple stats, then it will increase the counter for the stat that gains more from the training, or if both are equal, then your current locked in stat. The maximum count is 100,000. **Does not count muscle for any boosts or trainings.**

Certain trainings can increase the locked-in counter by more than 1, like Roadworks or Shadow Boxing.

As your Locked in Training count increases your stat gain will increase for that stat, and its effectiveness will also go up.

Doing a training for a different stat will lower your locked-in counter by 10 per training session. Once it reaches 0 then it will switch the locked in stat to whatever you are now training.

**1001**-**2000**: 2% gain boost

cards.name: Lean Benefits
cards.desc:
A build is considered lean when it is **below both** the Fat and Total Muscle requirements. Going past one **or** the other makes you lose out on the following benefits.

If your Weight turns red, then you are no longer lean.

Requirements are as follows:

- 4’11” (150 cm): 105lbs Fat or 133lbs Total Muscle
- 4’11” (152 cm): 107.6lbs Fat or 136.3lbs Total Muscle
- 5’0” (155 cm): 110.2lbs Fat or 139.6lbs Total Muscle
- 5’1” (157 cm): 112.8lbs Fat or 142.9lbs Total Muscle
- 5’2” (160 cm): 115.4lbs Fat or 146.2lbs Total Muscle
- 5’3”(162 cm): 118lbs Fat or 149.5lbs Total Muscle
- 5’4” (165 cm): 120.6lbs Fat or 152.8lbs Total Muscle
- 5’5” (167 cm): 123.2lbs Fat. or 156.1lbs Total Muscle
- 5’6” (170 cm): 125.8lbs Fat or 159.4lbs Total Muscle
- 5’7” (172 cm): 128.4lbs Fat or 162.7lbs Total Muscle
- 5’8” (175 cm): 131lbs Fat or 167lbs Total Muscle
- 5’9” (177 cm): 133.6lbs Fat or 170.3lbs Total Muscle
- 5’10” (180 cm): 136.2lbs Fat or 173.6lbs Total Muscle
- 5'11” (182 cm): 138.8lbs Fat or 176.9lbs Total Muscle
- 6’0” (185 cm):  141.4lbs Fat or 180.2lbs Total Muscle
- 6’1” (187 cm): 144lbs Fat or 183.5lbs Total Muscle
- 6’2” (190 cm): 146.6lbs Fat or 186.8lbs Total Muscle
- 6’3” (192 cm): 149.2lbs Fat or 190.1lbs Total Muscle
- 6’4” (195 cm): 151.8lbs Fat or 193.4lbs Total Muscle
- 6’5” (197 cm): 154.2lbs Fat or 196.7lbs Total Muscle
- 6’6”+ (200+ cm): 157lbs Fat or 200lbs Total Muscle

Lean builds get the following:

- **Critical Hits**, which are attacks that do 33% bonus damage or more if you have a card that boosts them, available only for lean builds. When you have base fat and muscles, you have a 25% chance for a critical hit. Your critical chance is lowered the closer you get to your lean caps, and going past one or both of those removes critical hits entirely.
- **Skill cooldowns** are all reduced by 15%, allowing you to do skills faster.
- **Faster run speed** than Fat or Muscle builds.
- **Two quick dashes** instead of one longer dash.

cards.name: Height Benefits
cards.desc:
Each inch away from the ideals of the heights decreases the buffs you get by 10%, except for being above 6’6, in which case the buff increases slightly.

The ideals are as follows: 4’11 for Low Height, 5’8 for Medium Height, 6’6 for Tall Height.

---

At 4’11 you have a 15% Agility boost, 33% higher Fighting Reflex charge rate, 10% faster evasive gain, bone breaking cooldown is decreased by 1 second, 2% higher chance to inflict cuts, dash distance is increased by 10% 107 Fat and 135 Total Muscle lean cap, 30% base crit chance on basic and heavy attacks, and 20% base crit chance on skills.

4’11 - 5’7: Each inch above 4’11 you lose 1.5% of the Agility boost (15% maximum) but gain 1% of the Stamina boost (10% maximum). Fighting Reflex charge rate boost decreases by 3.3%. Evasive charge rate decreases by 1%. Cut chance decreases by .2%. Dash distance decreases by 1%. Your Fat lean cap goes up by 2.6 Fat, and muscle lean cap goes up by 3.3 Total Muscle per inch. Crit chance lowers by .5% on basic and heavy attacks, but goes up by .5% on skills.

5’8: 10% Stamina boost, 132 Fat and 168 Total Muscle lean cap, 25% crit chance on all attacks.

5’9-6’5: Each inch above 5’9 you lose 1% of the Stamina boost (10% maximum), but gain .75% of the Strength and Durability boosts (7.5% maximum). Your Fat lean cap goes up by 2.6 Fat, and muscle lean cap goes up by 3.3 Total Muscle per inch. Crit chance lowers by .5% on basic and heavy attacks, but goes up by .5% on skills.

6’6: 7.5% Strength and Durability boost, 157 Fat and 202 Total Muscle lean cap, 20% base crit chance on basic and heavy attacks, and 30% base crit chance on skills.

6’6+: Each inch above 6’6 increases Strength and Durability boosts by .45%.

---

Being below 5’8 and 400 Weight increases your Critical Damage from 33% up to 50% as your weight decreases up to 0 weight.

Being below 5’8 and 200 Weight increases your Critical Chance up to 20% more the lower your weight is.

cards.name: Teaching
cards.desc:
Teaching is a system in which a stronger player can help out weaker players in training. To access the Teaching menu, open the Teaching app in your phone.

In order for someone to become a Teacher, they must reach Z- rank, allowing them to select up to 3 Disciples, which can be increased with certain psyches. Once you make someone your Disciple, you can not remove them as a Disciple for the next 24 hours.

A Disciple gets 10x more Battle XP gain when sparring with their teacher, allowing for faster progression with their teacher. This includes Strength from hitting, Durability from being hit, Stamina from consuming stamina, Agility from running, and Battle Sense from blocking.

On top of that, Disciples also a get a 3% stat boost for each rank difference between them and their teacher, up to a maximum of a 30% stat boost at a 10 rank gap. This boost only works as long as the Disciple and Teacher are in the same server.

When a Disciple reaches Z- rank they are instantly removed from their Teacher’s disciple list, losing all the benefits they received, but now being able to select other people as Disciples.

Teachers get a 3% stat boost for each Disciple they have in their server. They also get a 2x Battle XP boost from sparring with their Disciples.

cards.name: Trainer Fights
cards.desc:
You can choose to fight your Style or Mode Trainer for the style or mode that you use in order to increase your Mastery, or to unlock a Stance for your Fighting Style.

You can not fight a Trainer for a different style or mode than the one you use.

Beating your Style Trainer in a fight will reward you with 20% Style Mastery, while losing the fight will give 10% mastery.

Beating your Mode trainer in a fight will reward you with 15% Mode Mastery, while losing the fight will give 7.5% mastery.

There is a 30 minute cooldown before you can fight the Trainer again.

In order to unlock a Stance you must first have 100% Style Mastery, then you can fight the Style Trainer with them using that stance and its' respective skill in replace of the style locked skill, for example unlocking Adam Dudley’s MMA would have Muteba Gizenga use the stance and High Stick Shot in place of Dirty Tackle.

cards.name: Auto Macro Gamepass
cards.desc:
The [Auto Macro gamepass](https://www.roblox.com/game-pass/1087333934/Auto-Macro) can be bought for 1500 Robux, and will let the player automatically train.

There is also a free version of the Auto Macro given to everyone by default, which allows you to do the basic trainings. All other settings and trainings require the paid version.

To open the Auto Macro menu, click the 3 dots in the top left and then click the Menu button. From the Menu, scroll down to Auto Macro.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/67cb7bbcd60d3f279a5876a7/attachments/68ac2993df10583b79b7ab4a/download/image.png)

‌

The panel lets you customize your macro settings to however you prefer, letting you customize your training.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/67cb7bbcd60d3f279a5876a7/attachments/680d15e7b24688d61a0cb6be/download/image.png)

By default, the Auto Macro will automatically:

- Eat food in your inventory when your hunger goes below 30%.
- Sleep at 90% fatigue if you are by a bed.
- Train with whatever tool you have selected when activated.
- Keeps training after being gripped unless the tools are lost.
- Rejoin every 18 minutes to make sure you don’t get kicked by Roblox for inactivity.

‌

## Settings

---

- Auto Use Vests: Automatically equips vests and leg weights for trainings, must have at least 100 Stamina.
- Use Striking Logs: Attacks Striking Logs to train durability, stops when you go below 10% health and then swaps to your previous training until you heal up to 100% health again, repeating the process.
- Kick If Can’t Eat: Automatically kicks you from the game when you run out of food and reach 10% hunger, preventing you from losing muscle from starvation.
- Auto-Macro Enabled: Starts the Auto Macro, training with whatever tool you have equipped.
- Kick if Combat Tag: Automatically kicks you after you got combat tagged, only kicks once combat tag goes away to prevent a combat log.
- Kick if Can’t Macro: Automatically kicks you if your macro can not continue for any reason.
- Auto Use Xp-Boosts: Eats any xp boosting food that you have in your inventory, keeping the boost active for your training.
- Kick if High Fatigue and Can’t Sleep: Automatically kicks you from the game when your fatigue is past 90% and you are unable to sleep to lower it. Does not kick if you Indomitable Will.
- Auto Equip Breathing Mask: Will automatically equip the breathing mask if you own it, helping you gain more stamina.
- Kick If In Restricted Macro Area: Will automatically kick you out from the game if you are in an area where you can’t gain stats, like the hospital.
- Auto Shift Lock: Makes you lock on to the closest Punching Bag or Striking Log.
- Machine Trainings: Chooses if you will use certain trainings during your macro.

cards.name: Aikido
cards.desc:
## Mythic

---

- Heavenly Throw: Skyward Throw’s stun is 30% longer, concusses for 5 seconds, makes the enemy take 10% more damage for 10 seconds, and auto executes if it normally would’ve downed.
- Inner Circle Rebound: All skills deal more damage based on the attacker’s damage.
- Forceful Shift: Rotary shift throws opponents 100% further away, does 15% more damage, and stuns for 30% longer.

## Legendary

---

- Long Counter: Circular Redirect’s counter window is 25% longer.
- Forceful Shift: Rotary Shift has a 15% longer counter window
- Circular Motion: When landing Inner Circle Throw or Circular Redirect, a random skill decreases it’s cooldown by 5 seconds.
- Weakened Posture: Balance breaker makes the enemy take 7.5% more damage for 8 seconds.

## Rare

---

- Leg Breaker: Balance Breaker slows down enemies movement speed by 25% for 8 seconds.
- Redirected Momentum: Using a skill within 3 seconds of landing Circular Redirect make the skill a critical hit.
- Confusing Redirection: Circular Redirect stuns for 20% longer.
- Defense Shift: Rotary Shift deals 10% more damage.

## Common

---

- Inner Circle Slam: Inner Circle Throw does 10% more damage.
- Skyward Hurl: Skyward Throw does 10% more damage.
- Powerful Sweep: Balance Breaker does 15% more damage.
- Gravity Shift: Rotary Shift stuns for 10% longer.

cards.desc:
To claim a district you must be part of a gang. For information on gangs and how they work, check Gangs.

In order to capture a district you must stand in its' circle until completion reaches 100%. For each gang member you have in the circle, the completion time will increase. If another gang enters the area while you are trying to capture it, then the completion progress will halt until they are gone.

There are 5 districts around the map, called the Hangout District, Skatepark District, Basketball District, Backyard District, and Warehouse District.

Each district gives ₩200 every minute.

When a district is claimed by a gang, a server wide message will be shown. When a different gang tries stealing your district, you will be notified about the attack on your district.

cards.name: Van (Psyche Storage/Slots)
cards.desc:
Van can be found in the subway station. He will exchange Psyche Shards for ₩ or a Psyche Reroll. You can also give him Psyche Shards to unlock your Third and Fourth Psyche Slots.

Talking to Van will also give you the option to view your Psyche Storage, where you can swap out psyches loadouts. By default you will start with one Psyche Storage slot, and you can buy more for 350 Robux each, up to four slots. There is a 10 second cooldown between swapping slots, and you can not swap them while in combat.

Loadouts are all of your psyches, not individual psyches. If you only have one slot unlocked then you are not able to swap out any psyches.

You can exchange 10 Psyche Shard Pieces for 1 Psyche Shard.

## Exchange:

- 1 Psyche Shard: ₩250,000
- 1 Psyche Shard: Reroll one psyche
- 15 Psyche Shards: Unlock Third Psyche slot
- 30 Psyche Shards: Unlock Fourth Psyche slot.
- 30 Psyche Shards: Unlock a new psyche storage slot.
- ₩15,000,000: Unlock a new psyche storage slot.
- 10 Psyche Shard Pieces: 1 Psyche Shard

cards.desc:

You can upgrade stuff using Ryujin Coins or Won. If you don’t have the Won in your wallet, it will try using money from your bank account instead.

To close out of the menu click the Start button in the bottom left.

## Base Upgrades

Beds: ₩250,000 or 15 Ryujin Coins each, 5 max.

District Gains: ₩6,000,000 or 360 Ryujin Coins each, 5 max.

Vault Capacity: ₩15,000,000 or 1,500 Ryujin Coins each, 4 max. Increases capacity by 10,000,000 each upgrade.

Member Capacity: ₩3,500,000 or 125 Ryujin Coins each, 10 max. Increases member capacity by 35 each upgrade.

Gang Door Health: ₩250,000 or 25 Ryujin Coins, 4 max. Each level increases door health by 25%, up to 100%.

Gang Vault Health: ₩1,000,000 or 100 Ryujin Coins, 5 max. Each level increases vault health by 20,000, up to 100,000 more at max.

Officer Slots: ₩5,000,000 or 500 Ryujin Coins, 3 max.

Ally Slots: ₩25,000,000 or 2,500 Ryujin Coins, 2 max.

Recruiter Slots: ₩750,000 or 75 Ryujin Coins (increases each purchase), 6 max.

Increased XP: 500 Ryujin Coins (increases every 2 purchases), 10 max. Each level increases xp boost by 0.5%, increasing it to up 30% boost at max.

Functional Alarms: ₩1,250,000 or 125 Ryujin Coins, 1 max. When someone breaks in to your base alarms will go off and trigger a notification.

## Gang Levels:

Money and stats come from the gang leader.

- Level 1 (Base):  SS- Potential, 1m money or 100 RC. 15 members.
- Level 2: SSS- Potential, 2.5m money or 250 RC. 30 members.
- Level 3: X- Potential, 5m money or 500 RC, 60 members.
- Level 4: XX- Potential, 7.5m money or 750 RC, 100 members.
- Level 5 (Max): XXX- Potential, 10m money or 1000 RC, 150 members.

cards.name: Robber
cards.desc:
The Robber is a random encounter that can spawn in certain shady areas like alleyways. They have a 10% chance to spawn in alleyways, which increases to 25% if you have a job active.

They will attempt to rob the player for some money. You can deal with the robber by either giving him the money, attempting to intimidate him with your fame, or beating him up.

If your Fame or Bounty is above 25,000 then you can successfully intimidate him in to leaving you alone.

Robber scales off of your stats by 125%.

cards.name: Runner's High
cards.desc:
## Mythic

- Limitless Endorphins: When activating Runner’s High, gain 60% damage reduction for 7 seconds. Repeat this effect at 30% health.
- Mastered Runner’s High: Runner’s High lasts 25 seconds longer. You no longer gain any fatigue from activating it.
- Full Potential: Brekdak’s Forbidden skills do 5% more damage per use (15% max), have 5% less cooldown and automatically execute when they normally would’ve knocked someone out.

---

## Legendary

- Full Sprint: Runner’s High duration is 20% shorter. In return, you have a 25% shorter cooldown on Brekdak’s Forbidden skills.
- Running On The Edge: Under 50% stamina, gain 12.% movement speed and 10% damage reduction. Runner’s High no longer decreases stamina consumption.
- Unlocked Potential: Health and Muay Thai damage buffs for Runner’s High are increased by 5%.

---

## Rare

- Iron Shins: Brekdak’s Forbidden skills that use the lower body have their damage increased by 20%.
- Sharp Elbows: Brekdak’s Forbidden skills that use the upper body have their damage increased by 20%.

---

## Common

- Untiring: Runner’s High stamina consumption reduction is increased to 85%.

cards.name: Mode Bar & Conservation
cards.desc:
## **Mode Bar**

In order to activate your Mode, you must fill up the Mode Bar to 100%. You can fill up the mode bar in the following ways:

- Landing a Basic or Heavy attack gives 1/8 of the base damage, for example Boxing basic attack does 4.5 base damage which adds .56% charge.
- Landing a skill gives 1/4 of the base damage, for example Gazelle Punch does 12.12 base damage which adds 3.03% charge.
- Getting hit, each hit adding .35% charge.
- Blocking hits, each block giving .75% charge.
- Getting Perfect Blocks, each Perfect Block giving 4% charge.
- Land Block Counters, each Block Counter giving 2.5% charge.

If you are **not** lean, then you will get a **20%** boost to mode bar gains, for example Gazelle Punch would give a 3.63% charge.

Once the Mode Bar reaches 100% a popup will appear at the top of your screen saying that you can use your mode now.

When you are out of combat your mode bar will go down by 1% every 2 seconds.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/6880218271a1adc5d4cb5f88/attachments/688c005ac4dff22745bf4254/download/image.png)

## **Mode Conservation**

When you activate your mode it will start draining at a rate matching how long your mode lasts. For example, if your mode lasts for 100 seconds then it will go down at a rate of 1% a second.

You can deactivate your mode early in order to go back to normal, however you will not be able to charge up your mode again until it the mode bar reaches 0%.

Upon activating and deactivating your mode there is a 10 second cooldown before being able to switch, and each reactivation gives you 3 heart injury counts and 10% flat fatigue, along with any base fatigue activating your mode may give.

cards.name: World Event Information
cards.desc:
**World Events** start **every hour**, with the event picked randomly.

If you finish a World Event and receive rewards, there is a 30 minute cooldown before you can get rewards from a World Event again.

There are World Event specific achievements for winning multiple World Events, which boosts your gain from World Events.

cards.desc:
