In the server list you can choose any server to go, and can search by the name of the server. You can view the region, amount of players, and how old the server is.

cards.name: Raids
cards.desc:
Raids are long dungeons you have to go through, fighting off enemies and solving various puzzles to get through and reach the boss at the end. In order to start a Raid, talk to Soldier.

There are different ranks for raids depending on the player’s Total Power. They are split up in to the following: Beginner Rank at 0-4199 Total Power (F- to A+), Easy Rank at 4200-23999 Total Power (S- to X-), Medium Rank at 24000-79999 Total Power (X- to XXX+), Hard Rank at 80000-259999 Total Power (Z- to ZZZ+), and Impossible Rank at 260000+ Total Power (UR- and above).

The higher the rank of the dungeon the more enemies there are, the stronger they get, and the more difficult the bosses are. You can only do raids with people within 5 ranks of the strongest member in the group.

Once you finish a raid you will have a 24 hour cooldown until you can do another raid.

## Raids:

**Assassinate Erioh Kure:**

You and your party spawn outside of a heavily occupied Kure Manor. The task is to get in to the head’s room undetected, in order to assassinate Erioh while he is alone.

You start outside of the Manor needing to find a key to open the wooden gate. The key spawns inside of a house randomly, and you need to search around to find the key without getting caught. If an enemy detects you during this phase then a wave fight will start where you have to face off against security guards, with the key being the reward for beating them all.

Once you get past the wooden gate you then need to get through the courtyard undetected, reaching the manor safely. There are many enemies around, along with Hollis Kure who is roaming around the front of the manor and Fusui Kure who has a spotlight searching the outside of the manor and the entrance village.

If you stand inside of the spotlight then you will be detected and shot at with a sniper. If you fail to block the shot then you will take 10% damage.

Once you are inside of the manor then your goal is to get up to the third floor. The second floor has Yukusha Kure guarding it walking around the area.

If you get caught trying to sneak in to Erioh’s room at any time then Erioh will get some Kure members as security around him. This will make fighting him harder, as you also have to deal with the security forces while fighting him.

Getting to Erioh undetected allows you to fight Erioh alone. Erioh Kure uses all the Kure Tradition skills and has 120% Removal.

There is a 25% chance that instead of Erioh Kure there will be Ohma Tokita in the head’s room resting, in which case the player will have to fight Ohma instead. Ohma uses Niko Style and Advance.

The reward for assassinating Erioh is ₩750,000, 50 RC, and 1-1.5% Removal percentage.

The reward for assassinating Ohma is ₩1,000,000, 75 RC, 30 in all stats, and 1.5-2.5% Removal percentage.

Reward for beating raid (this is a separate reward from beating the boss):
₩100,000 * Difficulty (Beginner is 1, Impossible is 5)
20 RC * Difficulty
25 Stats * Difficulty

## Raid Reward Softcaps

These softcaps only apply when your **Total Power** is above the threshold, lowering stat gain from missions.

- 470000 (MR-): 50% Stat gain
- 595000 (EX-): 20% Stat gain
- 745000 (DX-) 7.5% Stat gain
- 900000 (?): 2.5% Stat gain
- 1250000 (??): 1% Stat gain
- 1750000 (???): .33% Stat gain.

## Raid Tokens

Completing raids gives Universal Raid Tokens plus raid-specific tokens. You can access the Token Shop from Roman.

- Main Boss: 30 tokens
- Alt boss (like Ohma): 45 tokens
- Mini-boss: 15 tokens

**Universal Token Shop** :

- 10 Tokens: ₩50,000
- 75 Tokens: 50 RC
- 150 Tokens: +0.5 Employee Level
- 20 Tokens: 15% XP boost 1 hour (12h cooldown)
- 20 Tokens: 3 Psyche Shard Pieces
- 200 Tokens: 1-inch height increase or decrease (caps 6'6 / 4'11)
- 150 Tokens: Permanent +5% stat gain on all **Rare** clans (caps at +20%)
- 200 Tokens: Permanent +5% stat gain on all **Legendary** clans (caps at +20%)

**Erioh Token Shop:**

- 60 Tokens: +0.5% Removal percentage
- 60 Tokens: +0.15% Guihun percentage
- 1,500 Tokens: **Kure Clan**
- 5 Tokens: 1 Universal Token
- 25 Tokens: 5 Universal Tokens
- 100 Tokens: 20 Universal Tokens
- 250 Tokens: 50 Universal Tokens
- 1000 Tokens: 200 Universal Tokens
- 1250 Tokens: Final Form card.

cards.name: PVP Events
cards.desc:
Every 60 minutes a Free For All (FFA) or Team Death Match (TDM) round will start, which will prompt players to ask if they wish to join the fight or not. All participating players will be teleported to a arena to fight each other.

## FFA

If you get knocked out then you are eliminated for the round and can not join back.

Each kill you get ₩25,000, 10 Ryujin Coins, and 10 in each stat (killing gang members gives half rewards). The last surviving player gets an additional ₩150,000, 50 Ryujin Coins, and 35 in each stat, and 50 Infamy.

After a round ends, a menu will pop up showing the amount of kills that each player had, who the last survivor was, and what your rewards are.

## TDM

Players are split in to two teams, Red and Blue. The first team to be eliminated loses, receiving a third of the rewards.

If there are less than 8 players participating in a TDM round then all rewards are halved.

Participating in the round gets you 20 in all stats and ₩50,000, only eligible if you get at least one kill. Each kill gets you ₩25,000, 10 Ryujin Coins, and 15 in each stat. The winning team gets 120 Ryujin Coins and ₩250,000 per 4 participants in the event.

There is also a chance at the following rewards:

- Psyche Shard Piece (20%)
- ₩100,000 (15%)
- 25 Ryujin Coins (15%)
- 3 Psyche Shard Pieces (15%)
- ₩250,000 (10%)
- 50 Ryujin Coins (10%)
- Psyche Shard (5%)
- ₩500,000 (5%)
- 75 Ryujin Coins (5%)

cards.name: Bounty
cards.desc:
Bounty is gained by committing crimes and doing Bounty Jobs. Gripping someone with high fame will give you 20% of their Fame as a Bounty reward.

## How to get Bounty:

- Break Cash Registers: 20 Bounty
- Breaking Vending Machines: 30 Bounty
- Break ATMs: 40 Bounty
- Robbing Players: 100 Bounty
- Gripping Players: 250 Bounty

There are also Bounty Jobs on boards in the [[hEcjFIet]] and outside of the [[d1iIdwKM]] that allow you to get extra bounty for certain actions.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/689a9f19f0471b608033d814/attachments/68a297940fc1e0c43d9a2998/download/image.png)

## Bounty Rewards:

- Gives access to buying from [[wa1k9TeP]] at 5,000 Bounty.
- Increases amount you rob up to 33% at 25,000 Bounty.
- Claim districts up to 20% faster at 25,000 Bounty.
- Combat tag goes away up to 20% faster at 30,000 Bounty.
- Vault damage is increased up to 10% at 100,000 Bounty.
- Stat gain is increased up to 15% at 150,000 Bounty.
- Top 100 Bounty users have their name in red in the player list.

cards.name: Stance Info
cards.desc:
Stances are off shoots of Fighting Styles that change their Scalings and have a unique skill.

Most stances will gear their scalings for different builds, like Upper Muscle or Strength focused players.

You can unlock stances in various ways depending on the stance. Some stances are locked behind a specific clan, others have quests to complete before unlocking them, and most require fighting the Style Trainer a few times.

Stance skills will still count as a style skill, so you can have 3 skills from the main style and the stance skill and still learn the style’s pure skill. This also mean style cards will affect the stance skill.

Stance scalings only affect the M1s, M2s, and stance skill, the main style skills will still use the main style scalings.

cards.name: Power Control
cards.desc:
The Power Control Menu can be opened by clicking the Muscle icon in the bottom left of the Stat Checker menu.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/68713325fcab6662c218c152/attachments/6a893a5b147d6d49fa7934ac/previews/6a893a5c147d6d49fa7934f2/download/image.webp)

Power control is split up in to two different sections, the free section and the gamepass only section.

![image.png](https://trello.com/1/cards/68713325fcab6662c218c152/attachments/6a893a1da2560e4456097346/download/image.png)

The free section allows you to change your total power, lowering all of your stats by a certain amount. You can also choose to toggle off or on the Invincible Body mechanic, which is what prevents people with 1/4 of your Durability in Strength from hitting you.

The gamepass sections allows for individual control of your stats, so you can customize them however you want to.

You can click the boxes above the lines to type in a specific percentage you want to set them to.

cards.name: Missions
cards.desc:
Missions are excursions out in to different areas to accomplish a random task. To start a Mission talk to Soldier.

Upon finishing the mission you will be rewarded with stats depending on how hard your mission was. _All Stat rewards are affected by_ [[BkUemkNW]]_._

For all Missions, enemies scale off of the strongest member in the party. If the strongest player in your party is more than 3 ranks stronger than you, then you will only get half of the stat reward.

**Easy**: Enemies have 50% of the strongest player’s stats. Completion gives a 10% xp boost for 10 minutes. 25% chance for Silver Pins from enemies.

**Normal**: Enemies have 75% of the strongest player’s stats. Completion gives a 10% xp boost for 15 minutes. 50% chance for Silver Pins from enemies.

**Hard**: Enemies have 100% of the strongest player’s stats. Also have to do Hard Tasks. Completion gives a 15% xp boost for 15 minutes.  100% chance for Silver Pins from enemies.

**Nightmare**: Enemies have 100% of the strongest player’s stats. Have to finish a Nightmare Mission. Completion gives a 15% xp boost for 20 minutes. 100% chance for Silver Pins from enemies.

**Lives:**

Depending on the difficulty you choose you will have a certain amount of lives. If you run out of lives then you will not be able to respawn and have to spectate your party as they try to finish the mission. If they finish the mission then you will still get rewards, but if everyone runs out of lives then the mission counts as failed.

Easy: Infinite Lives
Normal: 3 Lives
Hard: 2 Lives
Nightmare: 1 Life.

**Mission Tasks:**

- Resource Recovery: Find 4, 6, 8 (Easy, Normal, Hard) boxes.
- Save the Hostage: Bring hostage back to safety. Higher difficulty means they slow you down more (10%, 20%, 30% speed debuff) and need to rescue more (1, 2, 3). Getting hit makes you drop them.
- Lost Item: Find lost item. Guarded by some NPCs. Only appears on Easy and Normal difficulties.
- Clean Up: Beat 2, 5, 8 (Easy, Normal, Hard) NPCs.
- Leader: Beat the boss. Only appears on Hard difficulty.

**Hard Tasks:**

Failing a Hard Task will reduce your reward by 33%.

- Unbeatable: Stay above 50% health.
- Limited Footwork: Don’t use any dashes.
- Tank: Don’t use any Fighting Reflex.
- Punching Bag: Don’t use Evasive.

**Nightmare Missions:**

- Capture District: Your party has to fight through a horde of NPCs to try to take over a district, meanwhile enemies are constantly spawning and will pause/lower progression like normal players would.
- Heist: Have to break down a vault while fending off enemies. Enemies spawn every 10% you get through the vaults health. Vault starts at 800,000 health and increased by 100,000 for each additional party member.
- Steal Cargo: Break in to a warehouse and then steal a box from a cargo container. Person carrying the box has 67% slower movement speed, once cargo is taken security will start attacking the party trying to stop them from stealing it.

**Modifiers**:

You can add modifiers on to your missions to make them harder, in exchange for more rewards for completing them. You can select as many modifiers as you want. These are additive, so two .4 modifiers would add to .8, not multiply to .96.

- Invadable: Other players can invade your Missions. Increases xp boost timer by 180 seconds.
- Gotta Go Fast: Displays a timer at the top, no bonus.
- Freaks of Nature: All enemies get 500 extra Upper and Lower Muscle. Increases xp boost timer by 60 seconds.
- Double Trouble: Adds 2 bosses to the mission. Increases xp boost timer by 60 seconds.
- Chaos: Your Fighting Style and skills are all randomized. Increases xp boost timer by 90 seconds.
- Aware: NPCs can spot you from farther away. Increases xp boost timer by 30 seconds.
- No Regen: You can no longer regenerate health. Increases xp boost timer by 60 seconds.
- Weak: Players deal 20% less damage. Increases xp boost timer by 45 seconds.

**Repeated Missions:**

As you do multiple missions/invasions within a 24 hour period, you will start to gain less rewards from them, until 24 hours have passed from the first mission.

First 10: Unaffected
10-15: .8x gain
15-20: .5x gain
20-25: .3x gain
25-30: .15x gain
30+: .1x gain

cards.name: Burning City
cards.desc:
Requires at least **3 players** in the server to start.

A fire breaks out in the city and you have to help the injured. Each NPC has a timer above their head (150-240 seconds). To save an NPC, **carry them to the Infirmary** and drop them inside the marked area. The event ends when all NPCs are rescued or dead.

Burning buildings show a flame icon - the color shows how many citizens are left inside:

- **Yellow:** 1 injured citizen
- **Orange:** 2 injured citizens
- **Red:** 3+ injured citizens

## Rewards (per rescued NPC)

- 15 RC
- ₩30,000
- 1 Agility (affected by softcaps)

Whoever saves the most NPCs gets an **additional 25 RC and ₩60,000**. Rewards are only given after the event ends.

cards.name: Broken Bones
cards.desc:
For information on what broken bones do and how they occur, check [[jQoIoajh]].

As your bone count for each bones increases, the outline for the bone will change in color. They will start showing up for Ribs and Jaw once the bone reaches 2 bone break counts, and fully break at 5 counts. Meanwhile, for Arms and Legs they will start showing at 4 counts, and fully break at 7 counts.

cards.name: Fame
cards.desc:
If you do anything that would give you [[bmQSA7Tv]], then you lose twice as much Fame as you gained in Bounty, except for gripping a Bounty Poster target. For example, gripping someone would make you lose 500 Fame, unless you grab their Bounty Poster first.

Getting gripped by someone with a high Bounty (5,000+) will make you lose 20% of your Fame.

## How to get Fame

- Hunt down targets with [[rtdVTG58]] to get 50% of their Bounty as Fame.
- Grip a high Bounty player to get 10% of their Bounty as Fame.
- Gripping Thugs gives 150 Fame.
- Gripping Thug Leader gives 500 Fame.
- Gripping Mafia gives 200 Fame.
- Gripping Capo gives 750 Fame.
- [[KFem9CoI]] gives 1000 Fame.
- [[GVVdAoBQ]] gives 500 Fame.

## Fame Rewards:

- Take bounty target's bank money up to 5% at 25,000 Fame. Only works on people who you have taken the bounty poster for.
- Food is cheaper up to 50% discount at 30,000 Fame.
- Insurance is cheaper up to 20% discount at 50,000 Fame.
- Vault damage is increased up to 15% at 100,000 Fame
- Stat gain is increased up to 10% at 150,000 Fame.
- Top 100 Fame users get their name in yellow on the Player List.

cards.name: Invasions
cards.desc:
Invasions are where one player invades another party’s Mission in order to stop them from completing the Mission.

You can choose whether or not your Missions are invadable with a Modifier when creating your Mission. Enabling invaders increases the Mission rewards by 20%. Easy difficulty Missions can not turn on the Invadable modifier.

In order to invade another party talk to the Soldier and choose the invade option. You will be sent to a random party’s Mission as long as there is one available.

You can only invade Missions where the strongest player is within 3 Ranks of you, for example a Z rank play can invade parties where the strongest is between XXX- and ZZ-

If one of the attempting party’s members fully die then you get the full rewards for if you were to attempt the Mission on your own. For example a Normal Mission would reward you with 100 Stats in one and 45 in the others. If you manage to fully wipe out the whole party then you get a 50% boost the rewards.

cards.name: Scavenge
cards.desc:
Requires at least **5 players** in the server to start. Won and RC rewards increase with player count (caps at 20 players).

Crates spawn around the map. The event ends after **5 minutes** or when every crate has been claimed. Opening a crate drops **1-3 orbs** with random rewards.

**Orbs per crate:** 60% - 1 orb | 30% - 2 orbs | 10% - 3 orbs

## Orb rewards

- 25% - 10 Ryujin Coins
- 15% - ₩50,000
- 15% - 1 Skill Removal Token
- 10% - 1 Execution Key
- 10% - 3 Psyche Shard Pieces
- 10% - ₩75,000
- 10% - Random healing item (bandaids, eye drops, casts, crutches)
- 3% - 50 Ryujin Coins
- 2% - 1 Psyche Shard

cards.name: Cuts
cards.desc:
Cuts are gained randomly from being hit. Each cut lowers health regeneration by 2% and maximum health by 1%. To heal them, talk to [[kvw4OJi9]] or use a Bandaid.

cards.name: Bounty Posters
cards.desc:
Bounty Posters can be found inside of the [[j6nbtF2H]]. Taking a Poster will allow you to hunt someone with a high [[bmQSA7Tv]] (5000+ Bounty).

You can not grab a poster if you yourself has a high bounty. If you are under XXX rank you can not grab posters for people above XXX rank, and vice versa.

Hunting down a Bounty target will reward you with half of their Bounty as [[Y3D01k1E]], giving you certain rewards. You will also get all of their bounty as a Won reward.

Your target will be highlighted for 10 seconds every 2 minutes you are hunting them. They will also get a notification saying that someone has started hunting them.

If a Bounty target has been hunted within the last 15 minutes, then they can not be hunted with a poster again until the time is up.

cards.name: Adam Dudley's MMA (Street Fighting)
cards.desc:
Adam Dudley’s MMA is a [[MImGjGHg]] stance that is more focused on Strength and Upper Muscle. Learned from completing a quest from [[BRz4OgH4]].

---

Scalings increase your damage the higher your stats and muscles are. Stat scalings are a total multiplier of all the stat scalings added together. Muscle scaling is another multiplier on top of that. **These are not requirements to learn the style.**

Stat Scalings:

- Strength/110
- Agility/300

Muscle Scalings:

- Upper Muscle/216

---

cards.name: Roman (Raids/Missions/Silver Pins)
cards.desc:
The Soldier can be found in the second floor of the [[j6nbtF2H]]. He will allow you to start Raids or Missions, depending on which you pick.

Upon talking to him a UI will pop up allowing you to select Difficulty (if doing a Mission), Modifiers, and invite people to join you.

You can also choose to exchange your Silver Pins for the following:

- Mission XP, 1 Silver Pin for 1 XP.
- Ryujin Coins
  - 10 RC for 20 Silver Pins
  - 25 RC for 50 Silver Pins
  - 50 RC for 100 Silver Pins
  - 100 RC for 200 Silver Pins
- 10% Stat Gain Boost
  - 5 Minutes for 10 Silver Pins
  - 10 Minutes for 20 Silver Pins
  - 20 Minutes for 40 Silver Pins
  - 30 Minutes for 60 Silver Pins
  - 1 hour for 120 Silver Pins
- Wooden Bat for 100 Silver Pins
- Military Helmet for 150 Silver Pins
- Mafia Cloak for 200 Silver Pins

cards.name: Cargo Ship
cards.desc:
Requires at least **5 players** in the server to start.

The **Ikworsu ship** lands at the docks and needs players to help carry boxes from it to the marked spot. Every player in the server adds one more box. The ship sails away **5 minutes** after arrival.

Carrying a box slows you based on its size: Small - 24 | Medium - 16 | Large - 12

## Rewards per box

**Small:** 3 RC, 2.5-min 15% XP boost, 1 STR, 1 ST
**Medium:** 6 RC, 5.35-min 15% XP boost, 2.14 STR, 2.14 ST
**Large:** 9 RC, 10-min 15% XP boost, 8 STR, 8 ST
(All stat gains affected by softcaps.)

## Boss chance

After the event ends, [[wEBVQeZg]] has a chance to spawn (needs 4+ players): 6% base at 4 players, +4.5% per extra player, capped at **60%** chance to spawn.

cards.name: Facility Management
cards.desc:
You can manage your facility through the laptop in the [[d1iIdwKM]], allowing you to add more rooms to your gang base.

In the Facility Management room you can choose between multiple options, customizing where you want specific rooms to be. Deleting a room will not give you the money it took back, so think ahead.

## Rooms:

- Dojo Room (Bags, logs, and sparring space): 2.5m Cash or 250 RC (First) | 20m Cash or 2K RC (After)
- Bed Room (Multiple rooms filled with beds): 5m Cash or 500 RC (First) | 12.5m Cash or 1250 RC (After)
- Gym Room (Training machines: twists, bench press, barbell squat): 15m Cash or 1500 RC (First) | 30m Cash or 3K RC (After)
- Vault Room (Changes gang vault placement): 20m Cash or 2000 RC
- Kitchen Room (Gang kitchen): 10m Cash or 1000 RC

cards.name: Razor's Showman (Street Fighting)
cards.desc:
Razor’s Showman is a [[MImGjGHg]] stance that is more focused on Strength and Agility. Learned by beating [[BRz4OgH4]] in his Stance Fight 3 times.

---

Scalings increase your damage the higher your stats and muscles are. Stat scalings are a total multiplier of all the stat scalings added together. Muscle scaling is another multiplier on top of that. **These are not requirements to learn the style.**

Stat Scalings:

- Strength/110
- Agility/200

Muscle Scalings:

- Upper Muscle/316

---

Basic Attack: 4.9 base damage. .275 second debounce, 1.15x range.

Razor’s Edge:  Short dash forward slicing anyone in your way. 8.7 base damage, .8 second stun, 25 second cooldown. Bleeds for 1.5 seconds. Counts as a movement skill.

![giphy.gif](https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbGt1ZnZnaTg5MGppYzc2amp5cnZ2eHZ1Nm1qYWdid2hhbm5mZHFwOCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/cwbUSVNJygub9uNt9x/giphy.gif)

cards.name: Gang Wars
cards.desc:
Gang Wars: If both gangs have an Officer+ online and 5+ members on each side, every grip has a 5% chance to start a Gang War (grips between Allied+ gangs don't count). There is a 3 hour cooldown after a Gang War before another can start.

The war lasts 20 minutes with a live point counter:

- Gripping an enemy: 1 point
- Taking a district: .5 points
- Passive district holding: .5 points every 2 minutes
- Taking a gang base: 5 points

## Winning gang

- +(1 x points) to all stats
- (.5 x points) RC
- (₩1,500 x points) cash
- (10 x points) Infamy
- 15% XP boost for 30 minutes

## Losing gang

cards.name: Gang Relations
cards.desc:
Gang Relations is a representation of a gang’s relationship with other gangs. You can change your Gang’s Relation with another gang in the following ways:

- Steal a Gang Base: -10 Relations
- Steal a District: -1 Relation
- Grip a Gang Member: -1 Relation
- Make a Truce: Changes Relation to 0
- Add Ally: Changes Relation to 25
- Allyship: +5 Relations every 24 hours with Allies.

Gangs can have **2 allies** by default, upgradeable to **4**. Allies automatically join your Gang Wars for half rewards - if a gang is allied to both warring sides, they stay neutral.

---

## Relations:

**Enemy (-100 to -75)**

- Infamy from gripping or taking a base is **tripled**
- Rob **10% more** money from enemy gang members (not banks)
- Door/vault damage against each other +15%
- Apply **1 extra scar** when gripping
- Take districts **33% faster**
- Heal 10% more on knock

**Unfriendly (-74 to -25)**

- Infamy from gripping or taking a base is **doubled**
- Rob 5% more money, door/vault damage +5%

**Neutral (-24 to 24)** - no changes

**Allies (25 to 75)**

- Enter each other's gang bases freely
- Get 25% money from each other's districts
- Gain 25% of the gang base XP buff

**Coalition (76 to 100)**

- Enter each other's bases freely
- 50% district money and 50% of the base XP buff

Triceratops Fist: Grab your target and charge while holding them. Has different effects if you slam them in to a wall. 11.6 base damage on wall slam, 13.2 base damage on normal slam, 1.25 second stun on wall, 1.7 second ragdoll on slam, 29 second cooldown on miss, 38 second cooldown on hit. Increases Rib breaking count by 1. Can be used on ragdolled players.
